scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic and exact. Its sole non-elementary input is the published isosceles-trapezoid lemma for convex bicycle polygons; no numerical or exhaustive computation is used.
limitations: Only convex nondegenerate plane bicycle \((10,4)\)-gons are classified.
Nonconvex or self-intersecting solutions, other parameter pairs, and quantitative stability are not addressed.
A residual originality risk is an unindexed special-case argument not located in the inspected literature.
